objective_for_doctor:
Age: 54
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: shortness of breath

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m having significant shortness of breath or difficulty breathing. I also have pain (sharp, intensity 6/10) in the back of my neck, both shoulders, and both ankles. I have red skin lesions/redness on my cheek (left) and nose, larger than 1 cm, with some swelling (4/10) and mild itching (3/10). I also have painful mouth ulcers or sores.
Do you currently have a fever, or have you experienced chills or unusual temperature fluctuations recently?
Does the shortness of breath worsen when you take a deep breath, or do you have any sharp chest pain that increases with breathing or coughing?
Has your facial rash ever gotten worse or flared up after exposure to sunlight or UV light?
When did these symptoms start - did they all begin at the same time, and have they been getting progressively worse?
Do you have any patchy hair loss, hair thinning, or noticeable bald spots that developed recently?
Do your ankle joints appear visibly swollen or red right now, and can you move them without severe pain?
Have you noticed any blood in your urine, foamy or bubbly urine, or a decrease in your urine output recently?

Given the inability to gather additional history, I must base my assessment on the presenting constellation alone.

[DDX] Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), Mixed Connective Tissue Disease, Drug-induced Lupus Erythematosus, Systemic Vasculitis (ANCA-associated), Dermatomyositis
